name: Mephling
sourceDistinctions: The p. 11 sidebar mentions fast healing; pp. 11–12 give no player trait, amount, or conditions. No Mephling correction appears in the official errata or FAQ.
Four ancestries share the fixed 1d8 and 15-ft. cone. Damage type varies. DC uses Hit Dice and Constitution rather than effective character level.
The standard action and supernatural classification come from the core breath rules, while the racial entry supplies its own damage, save, uses, and interval.
Only matching spell descriptors gain caster level. Only Air gains flight, and Water’s swim speed does not confer water breathing.
portraitForm: Pip Reedwhistle, an original Air Mephling Bard
